verdict.rationale: The evidence shows some admin-level gating of agent capabilities. Computer Use is controlled by an organization-level 'Enable desktop mode' toggle, and the CLI's --sandbox flag enforces deny rules and can restrict network traffic at the OS level. Neither amounts to per-integration access control over which external tools the agent may use. Missing for 10: an explicit admin allowlist/denylist for integrations (e.g., Slack, Jira, Linear, MCP servers), per-tool permission scoping for cloud sessions, role-based policy docs, and independent corroboration.
